title: 查询无效交易
summary: 交易金额超过一千，或同名用户在六十分钟内于不同城市交易时无效，返回输入中所有无效交易字符串。
insight: 先解析每条交易并标记金额违规项，再逐对比较同名交易的时间和城市；满足跨城时间条件时两条都标为无效，最后按原输入顺序收集。
pitfalls: 跨城冲突会同时使两笔交易无效
时间差取绝对值且六十分钟边界包含
返回原始交易字符串而非解析后的字段

solutions.title: 解析后两两标记
solutions.idea: 利用交易数上限直接检查所有可能冲突对。
steps: 把每条字符串解析为 name、time、amount、city，amount>1000 时标记
枚举 i<j；若姓名相同、城市不同且时间差<=60，将 i、j 都标记
按原下标顺序把已标记的原字符串加入答案

code.java: class Solution { static class Transaction{String raw,name,city;int time,amount;Transaction(String raw){this.raw=raw;String[] parts=raw.split(",");name=parts[0];time=Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);amount=Integer.parseInt(parts[2]);city=parts[3];}}public List<String> invalidTransactions(String[] input){int n=input.length;Transaction[] transactions=new Transaction[n];boolean[] invalid=new boolean[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++){transactions[i]=new Transaction(input[i]);invalid[i]=transactions[i].amount>1000;}for(int i=0;i<n;i++)for(int j=i+1;j<n;j++){Transaction a=transactions[i],b=transactions[j];if(a.name.equals(b.name)&&!a.city.equals(b.city)&&Math.abs(a.time-b.time)<=60)invalid[i]=invalid[j]=true;}List<String> answer=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=0;i<n;i++)if(invalid[i])answer.add(input[i]);return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private data class Transaction(val raw:String,val name:String,val time:Int,val amount:Int,val city:String);fun invalidTransactions(input:Array<String>):List<String>{val transactions=input.map{raw->val parts=raw.split(',');Transaction(raw,parts[0],parts[1].toInt(),parts[2].toInt(),parts[3])};val invalid=BooleanArray(input.size){transactions[it].amount>1000};for(i in transactions.indices)for(j in i+1 until transactions.size){val a=transactions[i];val b=transactions[j];if(a.name==b.name&&a.city!=b.city&&kotlin.math.abs(a.time-b.time)<=60){invalid[i]=true;invalid[j]=true}};return input.indices.filter{invalid[it]}.map{input[it]}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { struct Transaction{string raw,name,city;int time,amount;};public:vector<string> invalidTransactions(vector<string>& input){vector<Transaction> transactions;vector<bool> invalid(input.size());for(int i=0;i<(int)input.size();++i){stringstream stream(input[i]);string name,time,amount,city;getline(stream,name,',');getline(stream,time,',');getline(stream,amount,',');getline(stream,city,',');transactions.push_back({input[i],name,city,stoi(time),stoi(amount)});invalid[i]=transactions.back().amount>1000;}for(int i=0;i<(int)input.size();++i)for(int j=i+1;j<(int)input.size();++j){auto& a=transactions[i];auto& b=transactions[j];if(a.name==b.name&&a.city!=b.city&&abs(a.time-b.time)<=60)invalid[i]=invalid[j]=true;}vector<string> answer;for(int i=0;i<(int)input.size();++i)if(invalid[i])answer.push_back(input[i]);return answer;} };
